Keywords: pr, pull request, merge request, description, summary
Structure: Summary (outcome first, one or two sentences) / Why / How / Testing (commands and results) / Risks and rollback / Follow-ups.
Pitfalls: Describing the process instead of the result; no test evidence; hiding known risks.

Structure: type(scope): imperative summary under 72 characters; blank line; body explaining why, not what.
Pitfalls: 'fix stuff'; bundling unrelated changes in one commit.

Keywords: adr, decision record, architecture decision, trade-off
When to Use: A significant design choice with trade-offs others will ask about later.
Structure: Title / Status / Context / Decision / Alternatives considered / Consequences.
Pitfalls: Writing it after the fact without the alternatives that were rejected.

Keywords: postmortem, incident report, retrospective, rca, root cause analysis
Structure: Summary and impact / Timeline / Root cause and contributing factors / What went well / Action items with owners and dates.
Pitfalls: Blaming people; action items without owners; stopping at the trigger instead of the systemic causes.

Keywords: design doc, rfc, proposal, technical design, migration plan, runbook
When to Use: Large features, migrations and cross-team changes before building.
Structure: Problem and goals / Non-goals / Proposed design / Alternatives / Rollout and rollback / Risks / Open questions.
Pitfalls: Writing the doc after the code; no non-goals; no rollback plan.

When to Use: Reporting a defect for someone else to fix.
Structure: Summary / Steps to reproduce / Expected / Actual / Environment / Logs or screenshots / Severity.
Pitfalls: No repro steps; several bugs in one report.

Keywords: review report, review findings, review comments
When to Use: Reporting the results of a code review.
Structure: Verdict first / Blocking findings (file:line, scenario, fix) / Optional suggestions / What was checked.
Pitfalls: Findings without a failure scenario; mixing blocking and optional items.

Keywords: status update, stakeholder update, progress report, eta
Structure: Current state / Impact / What is being done / Next update time or ETA / Asks.
Pitfalls: Technical detail stakeholders cannot use; missing the next update time.
